articles.summary: Ferrara's launches kept beating their concept scores. With Conveo, shoppers tasted the candy on camera first, then wrote the concept. 8 in 10 say it matches.
articles.title: Ferrara uses Conveo to close the gap between concept score and launch sales

articles.summary: HeliosX launched generic GLP-1s in Canada on 48 hours' notice by mining Conveo consumer interviews it had run months earlier, for a different question.
articles.title: HeliosX Launched Generics in 48 Hours with Conveo | Conveo
